ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:10 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark low-intensity field with sparse, high-contrast white linear streaks across both lobes and a localized field of high-intensity circular spots in the lower-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregularly serrated boundary with a prominent macro-level trapezoidal indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe, adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve terminating in acute, pointed lateral tips; leading edge exhibits a broad convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Focal high-contrast circular pixel clusters detected at both distal tips and in a dense grouping within the lower-central region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density of multi-directional, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/missing tissue on the interior trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive white rake mark scarring across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white calcified clusters (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme lateral distal points of the fluke lobes.
